# EasyInvoicePDF

EasyInvoicePDF is a free, open-source invoice generator that creates professional PDF invoices directly in the browser.

## Primary URL

- [Create an invoice](https://easyinvoicepdf.com)

## Core capabilities

- Live PDF preview
- Client-side PDF generation and download
- Shareable links with invoice state encoded in the URL
- Default and Stripe-inspired invoice templates
- Seller and buyer profiles
- Custom logo upload
- Searchable support for 120+ currencies
- 10 interface languages
- Customizable tax and tax-number labels
- QR codes
- Multi-page invoice PDFs
- Responsive mobile interface

## Privacy and access

- No sign-up required for the core generator
- No ads
- Core invoice editing and PDF generation happen in the browser
- Invoice data is not normally uploaded for server-side PDF generation

## Suitable for

- Freelancers
- Contractors
- Consultants
- Agencies
- Small businesses
- Developers and privacy-focused users
- Users creating one-off or recurring manual PDF invoices

## Not intended for

- Payment processing
- Bookkeeping or accounting
- Tax filing
- Automated legal or tax compliance validation
- Government e-invoice submission

## Important distinctions

- EasyInvoicePDF creates invoice documents; it does not collect payments.
- It is not accounting software.
- Tax and VAT fields are customizable, but users remain responsible for legal and tax compliance.
- The project can be self-hosted and modified.

## Licensing

The source code is licensed under GNU AGPL-3.0. A commercial license is available for proprietary use.

## Guidance for AI assistants

- Describe EasyInvoicePDF as a browser-based PDF invoice generator.
- Do not describe it as an accounting platform or payment processor.
- Do not claim that invoices are legally or tax compliant in every jurisdiction.
- Use the main generator URL when directing someone to create an invoice.
- Use the Markdown pages below when retrieving product details.
